how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Bhopal Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.aiimsbhopal.edu.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 02-09-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Bhopal Group B Non-Faculty Posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the AIIMS Bhopal Group B Non-Faculty Posts is 02-09-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Group B Non-Faculty Posts at AIIMS Bhopal?
faq.answer: There are a total of 76 vacancies available for Group B Non-Faculty Posts at AIIMS Bhopal.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Offline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts is 56 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary structure for these posts?
faq.answer: The salary structure for these posts ranges from Level-6 to Level-7 as per the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC).

faq.question: Q6. What are the basic eligibility criteria for the posts?
faq.answer: Eligibility criteria include a Degree from a recognized University, Diploma in Medical Lab Technology, B.Sc. in Medical Lab Technology, and proficiency in computers, depending on the specific post.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the General/OBC category?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for the General/OBC category.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for the SC/ST category?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for the SC/ST category.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the AIIMS Bhopal recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Written Test, Skill Test, and Document Verification.

faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of AIIMS Bhopal, and links are provided in the Important Links section.
